# Summary

What this changes, and why.

# Verification

How you checked it: the commands you ran, and any app or example you exercised.

- [ ] `cargo fmt --all`
- [ ] `cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings`
- [ ] `cargo test --workspace`
- [ ] docs updated, if this changes behavior a user can see
- [ ] if this breaks existing apps: the `C-Breaking-Change` label and a note in `docs/migration/unreleased/` (see CONTRIBUTING.md)
